evals.input: @google-tasks add review the proposal tomorrow to Work

ai.instructions:
- Search with search-tasks before get-task, update-task, complete-task, reopen-task, or delete-task. Pass both id and listId from those results. Never invent task or list ids.
- search-tasks returns compact snippets. Call get-task when you need the full notes.
- search-tasks pages results. If hasMore is true, call it again with the same query, view, and list, and offset set to nextOffset, until hasMore is false. Never invent offsets. Do not say pagination failed when nextOffset is present.
- Default search view is open tasks. Use view=overdue, today, upcoming, undated, or completed when the user asks for those.
- Do not dump the user's entire task list into the chat. Summarize, and keep paging only when the user needs a complete pass.
- Due dates are calendar dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Google Tasks does not store a time of day.
- If the user names a list, pass listName or a listId from list-task-lists. If they do not, create-task uses the last list they created into.
- complete-task marks a task done. reopen-task brings a completed task back. delete-task is permanent and asks the user to confirm.
- If Google sign-in fails, tell the user to open View Tasks, add their OAuth Client ID if needed, and sign in.
